Lucide icon source provenance
=============================

Icons:
- git-fork
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/a79b2d131dab2bf20cb224bd0937b439a9c4fa99/icons/git-fork.svg
- git-compare-arrows
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lucide-icons/lucide/a79b2d131dab2bf20cb224bd0937b439a9c4fa99/icons/git-compare-arrows.svg

Pinned Lucide commit: a79b2d131dab2bf20cb224bd0937b439a9c4fa99
Modifications: changed rendered size from 24x24 to 16x16; replaced currentColor with #6C707E for light themes and #CED0D6 for dark themes. Original 24x24 viewBox, paths, circles, stroke width, line caps, and line joins remain unchanged.
